description: Base Renovate preset for @unabandoned forks: keep dependencies current, soak new releases before adopting them, automerge once green, pin the supply chain, flag anything that itself becomes abandoned, and fast-track security fixes.

packageRules.description: Suppress abandonment flags only for abandoned zero-dependency leaf clones we neither ship to consumers nor plan to fork or vendor - pure dashboard noise, nothing to act on. Anything abandoned that ships in a published @unabandoned tree (e.g. ret) or that we vendor or intend to fork stays flagged (save for the reviewed frozen-leaf exception in the next rule), because that is an actionable signal we do not want to hide.

Also suppress abandonment flags for abandoned packages that are frozen at their latest release with a fully-current, zero-dependency subtree - there is no transitive tree left to rot, so the flag carries no actionable signal (a direct CVE is still surfaced by the vulnerabilityAlerts above). Reviewed 2026-08 during the detective/browser-pack adoption: these ship in, or are dev deps of, @unabandoned/browser-pack and @unabandoned/module-deps, and none is a fork or vendor candidate.
